title: Payoff Plan Margin by Card Tier and Account Age — Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
The plan margin of a Ridgeline Consumer Credit deferred-interest payoff plan is the percentage by which the deferred-interest balance is increased before it is divided into the plan's drafts. It is set by the card's tier and the full months the account has been open since its opening date.

| Account | Full months open | Plan margin |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred or Card Premier | 36 or more | 1 percent |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred or Card Premier | at least 12 but fewer than 36 | 2.5 percent |
| every other account, Card Classic included, and a Preferred or Premier card open fewer than 12 full months | any | 5 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical openings)

| Tier | Opened | Today | Full months | Plan margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Card Premier | 10 March 2023 | 10 March 2026 | 36 | 1 percent |
| Card Premier | 10 March 2023 | 9 March 2026 | 35 | 2.5 percent |
| Card Preferred | 10 March 2025 | 10 March 2026 | 12 | 2.5 percent |
| Card Preferred | 10 March 2025 | 9 March 2026 | 11 | 5 percent |
| Card Classic | 10 March 2019 | 10 March 2026 | 84 | 5 percent |

## Hypothetical effect

A deferred-interest balance of 1900.00 increased by 1 percent is 1919.00; by 2.5 percent, 1947.50; by 5 percent, 1995.00.
